fields.Name: International Cheese Federation Events Archive
fields.Description: This page serves as an archive of past and upcoming events hosted by the International Cheese Federation. It features details on various webinars covering topics like judging standards, rennet alternatives, and wholesale negotiation, alongside workshops on cheesemaking techniques and curd retailing, and highlights from the annual conference.
